name: Starting Shelf Island

views.label: Detail 5: The door and its towers

desc: a floating shelf of dark rock 40 m wide and 56 m long with a ragged asymmetric outline, about 6 m thick at the rim and tapering into an inverted cone 48 m deep with a faint bronze vein glowing inside it, six thick rusted chains hanging from bronze rim rings into the haze. At the near end is the SPAWN TERRACE, an irregular paved patch about 13 x 9 m of cracked slabs of different sizes, with a shallow bronze arrival disc (3.6 m across, three concentric rings, slightly sunken and cracked) at its centre and a low broken rock lip behind it; a tiny plain 1.8 m human silhouette stands on the disc facing the door in every view for scale. A broken road of uneven worn slabs about 4 m wide, with a thin broken bronze inlay line, leads about 11 m to THE BEAM: one colossal weathered bronze I-girder 16 m long with a 2.5 m wide top, lying slightly crooked (about 15 degrees off the straight line) across a ragged meandering crack that cuts the whole island from rim to rim, 8 to 11 m wide with stepped broken lips and a 60 m drop into haze; the beam is level but dented, rust-streaked, matte, dusty, with missing rivets and a chipped corner, never polished. Beyond it a broken irregular forecourt about 13 x 4 m, then three worn uneven steps rising to THE DOOR, shown LOCKED, cut into the face of a huge black rock cliff with raw rock on both sides: 8 m high, carved stone frame 7.6 m wide with a crown of bronze finials, battered green-bronze verdigris scrollwork leaves dark with soot, two thick rusted chains wound across both leaves held by one huge closed padlock, a thin bright amber line of light through the centre gap, exactly like the Core Fantasy key-art door. Behind the door the cliff holds a walkable antechamber: a 3 m passage, then an irregular carved hall about 16 x 11.5 m with an 11 m cracked ceiling, four stout columns (two whole, two broken) around a clear aisle, a low round dais 4.5 m across where three weapons hover, one shaft of amber light through a ceiling hole, a small west alcove, and a 4 m exit tunnel in the east wall opening onto a rock ledge on the cliffs east face where a fixed bridge leaves toward the next island. A very tall ruined carved tower (60 m, irregular broken tiers, sheared top, a few dim amber windows, no domes) and a shorter leaning half-collapsed tower (36 m) grow out of the cliff above the hall, with six jagged black rock spires of 20 to 48 m between and around them. Three bare dead trees (6 m, 4.5 m, and a 2.8 m broken stump) stand off the road, a few small uneven clumps of dry grass, and rubble in uneven scatters of different-sized stones; no mirror symmetry anywhere, immense, silent and ominous; match the attached approved ENV-01 hero image and blueprint sheets exactly, and add no second floating island or extra rock in the background
short: Crooked ravine, weathered beam, locked door in a cliff, walkable antechamber

desc: a trail of fire sparks and ember streaks kicked up behind Elias as he runs, small bright points streaming back along his path, as in the Flow Over Force key art
short: Sparks kicked up while running

name: Ambient Ember Sparks
desc: slow floating fire sparks and glowing embers drifting upward in warm dusty air, varied sizes, some larger glowing flakes, used around Elias and across the islands
short: Drifting embers

name: Combat Flame Ring
desc: a controlled ring of orange flame circling Elias at waist height, a bright thin hot core with soft licking tongues of fire, restraint not chaos, as in the Combat Restraint key art
short: Controlled ring of flame

name: Hidden-System Energy Orbs
desc: floating glowing orbs of amber light connected by thin bright energy threads in a loose lattice, some orbs bright and some dim, as in the Hidden System key art
short: Orbs joined by energy threads

name: Dragon Fire Breath
desc: a long roaring jet of orange fire with a white-gold core streaming from a dragon jaw outline, swirling smoke and embers, hot and powerful
short: Fire stream from the dragon

name: Ring of Fire, Dormant and Ignited
desc: a vast circle of embers: shown dormant as a faint ring of dull glowing coals along a distant horizon, and ignited as a towering wall of fire with leaping flames and sparks, proposed final-world boundary
short: World-edge ring, dormant and lit
